selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is a small copy of the big world compared to in this part?
questions.answer: A human being.

questions.question: What is described as a bright small sample of the whole Qur’an?
questions.answer: Surah al-Fatihah.

questions.question: What are the daily prayers said to be like for all kinds of worship?
questions.answer: A full guide or summary of them.

questions.question: Do the daily prayers show only one kind of worship or many kinds?
questions.answer: Many kinds.

questions.question: What picture word is used to show that the prayers help point the way?
questions.answer: A map.

questions.question: What does that map point to?
questions.answer: Different kinds and levels of worship.

questions.question: Whose worship is included in this part?
questions.answer: The worship of all groups of creatures.

questions.question: If something is called an index, what does that help us understand about the prayers?
questions.answer: They gather many things together in a short way.

questions.question: In this passage, what is man compared with?
questions.answer: A little model of the larger world.

questions.question: In this passage, what is Surah al-Fatihah compared with?
questions.answer: A small shining example of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are the prescribed prayers compared with?
questions.answer: A bright summary and a holy map.

questions.question: What does the comparison with Surah al-Fatihah help us understand about the prayers?
questions.answer: That a smaller thing can show the meaning of a greater whole.

questions.question: Are the prayers presented as narrow or wide in meaning?
questions.answer: Wide in meaning.

questions.question: What do the prayers gather together?
questions.answer: All the different kinds of worship.

questions.question: What does the word sacred tell us about the map of worship?
questions.answer: It is holy and important.

questions.question: What can we infer about worship from this passage?
questions.answer: Worship is not just one simple form; it has many forms.

questions.question: What two small examples are named before the prayers are described?
questions.answer: A person and Surah al-Fatihah.

questions.question: What big things do those two small examples connect to?
questions.answer: The world and the whole Qur’an.

questions.question: Following those examples, what are the prescribed prayers said to be?
questions.answer: A full and shining guide to worship.

questions.question: What do the prayers point toward besides human worship?
questions.answer: The worship of all creatures.

questions.question: Does the passage say the prayers hide worship or show it?
questions.answer: They show it.

questions.question: If all classes of creatures are mentioned, what does that tell us about Allah’s creation?
questions.answer: Many different creatures serve and worship Him in their own ways.

questions.question: What is one central message of this short passage?
questions.answer: The prescribed prayers help us understand many kinds of worship in all creation.

questions.question: What big idea about worship is taught in this passage?
questions.answer: The prescribed prayers gather, show, and point to the worship spread throughout all creation.
